spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders
FROM order_metrics;

SELECT
    restaurant_id,
    COUNT(*) AS orders,
    ROUND(AVG(actual_delivery_min), 2) AS avg_delivery_time,
    ROUND(AVG(delay_min), 2) AS avg_delay
FROM order_metrics
GROUP BY restaurant_id
ORDER BY avg_delay DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    alert_type,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM delivery_alerts
GROUP BY alert_type
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    severity,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM delivery_alerts
GROUP BY severity;

SELECT
    status,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM delivery_alerts
GROUP BY status;

SELECT
    cuisine,
    COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders_current
GROUP BY cuisine
ORDER BY orders DESC;

SELECT
    cuisine,
    ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders_current
GROUP BY cuisine
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT
    cuisine,
    ROUND(AVG(order_value), 2) AS aov
FROM orders_current
GROUP BY cuisine
ORDER BY aov DESC;

SELECT
    location,
    COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders_current
GROUP BY location
ORDER BY orders DESC;

SELECT
    location,
    ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders_current
GROUP BY location
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT
    restaurant_id,
    COUNT(*) AS orders,
    ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(order_value), 2) AS aov
FROM orders_current
GROUP BY restaurant_id
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT SUM(on_time_flag) AS on_time_deliveries
FROM order_metrics;

SELECT
    distance_km AS distance,
    order_value
FROM orders_current
WHERE distance_km IS NOT NULL
  AND order_value IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    location,
    cuisine,
    COUNT(*) AS orders,
    ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders_current
GROUP BY location, cuisine
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_events
FROM food_delivery_events;

SELECT
    event_type,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM food_delivery_events
GROUP BY event_type
ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT
    kafka_partition,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM food_delivery_events
GROUP BY kafka_partition
ORDER BY kafka_partition;

SELECT
    ingested_at AS time,
    COUNT(*) AS events
FROM food_delivery_events
GROUP BY ingested_at
ORDER BY ingested_at;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS quality_issues
FROM data_quality_log;

SELECT
    issue_type,
    COUNT(*) AS issue_count
FROM data_quality_log
GROUP BY issue_type
ORDER BY issue_count DESC;

SELECT
    STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(triggered_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time,
    COUNT(*) AS alerts
FROM delivery_alerts
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
FROM orders_current;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM orders_current;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_value), 2) AS average_order_value
FROM orders_current;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(actual_delivery_min), 2) AS avg_delivery_time
FROM order_metrics;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(delay_min), 2) AS avg_delay
FROM order_metrics;

SELECT
    STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(event_timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders
FROM food_delivery_events
WHERE event_type = 'ORDER_PLACED'
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
    location,
    ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders_current
GROUP BY location
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(delay_min), 2) AS average_delay
FROM order_metrics;

SELECT
    cuisine,
    ROUND(SUM(order_value), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders_current
GROUP BY cuisine
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT
    payment_method,
    COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders_current
GROUP BY payment_method
ORDER BY orders DESC;

SELECT
    event_type,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM food_delivery_events
GROUP BY event_type
ORDER BY event_count DESC;

SELECT
    HOUR(event_timestamp) AS hour_of_day,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders
FROM food_delivery_events
WHERE event_type = 'ORDER_PLACED'
GROUP BY hour_of_day
ORDER BY hour_of_day;

SELECT
    location,
    ROUND(AVG(actual_delivery_min), 2) AS avg_delivery_time
FROM order_metrics
GROUP BY location
ORDER BY avg_delivery_time DESC;

SELECT
    location,
    ROUND(AVG(delay_min), 2) AS avg_delay
FROM order_metrics
GROUP BY location
ORDER BY avg_delay DESC;

SELECT
    e.traffic_level,
    ROUND(AVG(m.actual_delivery_min), 2) AS avg_delivery_time,
    ROUND(AVG(m.delay_min), 2) AS avg_delay
FROM order_metrics m
JOIN food_delivery_events e
    ON m.order_id = e.order_id
WHERE e.event_type = 'ORDER_PLACED'
GROUP BY e.traffic_level
ORDER BY avg_delivery_time DESC;

SELECT
    e.weather,
    ROUND(AVG(m.actual_delivery_min), 2) AS avg_delivery_time,
    ROUND(AVG(m.delay_min), 2) AS avg_delay
FROM order_metrics m
JOIN food_delivery_events e
    ON m.order_id = e.order_id
WHERE e.event_type = 'ORDER_PLACED'
GROUP BY e.weather
ORDER BY avg_delivery_time DESC;

SELECT
    distance_km AS distance,
    actual_delivery_min AS delivery_time
FROM order_metrics
WHERE distance_km IS NOT NULL
  AND actual_delivery_min IS NOT NULL;
